# Tabs

> Segmented and browser-style navigation with a stable active indicator.

This file matches the installed `tabs` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/tabs.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/tabs.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/tabs-knobs`: `tabsKnobs`, types `TabsKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/tabs`: `TabsSurface`, `Tabs`, `TabsList`, `TabsTab`, `TabsPanel`, types `TabsProps`, `TabsListVariant`, `TabsListProps`, `TabsTabProps`, `TabsPanelProps`, `TabsSurfaceProps`

## Composition

### Anatomy

```tsx
<Tabs>
  <TabsList>
    <TabsTab />
  </TabsList>
  <TabsPanel />
</Tabs>
```

### Connected surface

```tsx
<Tabs>
  <TabsList>
    <TabsTab />
  </TabsList>
  <TabsSurface>
    <TabsPanel />
  </TabsSurface>
</Tabs>
```

### Closable tab

A close button can't sit inside the tab's own button: wrap each TabsTab and its icon-only Button in a relative span, place the Button absolutely at the end, and reserve its room with --cui-tabs-trigger-padding-inline-end on the TabsTab.

```tsx
<Tabs>
  <TabsList>
    <span>
      <TabsTab />
      <Button />
    </span>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsPanel />
</Tabs>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { XIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { flushSync } from "react-dom";
import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button";
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsPanel, TabsTab } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/tabs";

const editorFiles = [
  { name: "index.tsx", description: "Application entry point." },
  { name: "tabs.tsx", description: "Browser-style tabs with connected corners." },
  { name: "theme.css", description: "Token-driven tab surfaces." },
];

function ClosableEditorTabs() {
  const [openFiles, setOpenFiles] = useState(editorFiles);
  const [activeFile, setActiveFile] = useState("tabs.tsx");

  const closeFile = (name: string) => {
    const index = openFiles.findIndex((file) => file.name === name);
    const remaining = openFiles.filter((file) => file.name !== name);
    setOpenFiles(remaining);
    if (name === activeFile) setActiveFile(remaining[Math.min(index, remaining.length - 1)]?.name ?? "");
  };

  if (openFiles.length === 0) {
    return (
      <Button
        variant="surface"
        className="self-start"
        onClick={() => {
          setOpenFiles(editorFiles);
          setActiveFile("tabs.tsx");
        }}
      >
        Reopen files
      </Button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Tabs value={activeFile} onValueChange={setActiveFile}>
      <TabsList variant="browser" aria-label="Open files">
        {openFiles.map((file) => (
          <span key={file.name} className="relative inline-flex items-center">
            <TabsTab
              value={file.name}
              aria-keyshortcuts="Delete"
              onKeyDown={(event) => {
                if (event.key !== "Delete" && event.key !== "Backspace") return;
                const list = event.currentTarget.closest('[role="tablist"]');
                flushSync(() => closeFile(file.name));
                list?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[role="tab"][aria-selected="true"]')?.focus();
              }}
              style={{ "--cui-tabs-trigger-padding-inline-end": "calc(var(--control-h-xs) + var(--spacing) * 2)" }}
            >
              {file.name}
            </TabsTab>
            {/* A tablist may only own tabs: keyboard and screen reader users close the focused tab with Delete instead. */}
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="xs"
              iconOnly
              aria-hidden
              tabIndex={-1}
              aria-label={`Close ${file.name}`}
              className="absolute end-1 z-10"
              onClick={() => closeFile(file.name)}
            >
              <XIcon />
            </Button>
          </span>
        ))}
      </TabsList>
      {openFiles.map((file) => (
        <TabsPanel key={file.name} value={file.name}>
          {file.description}
        </TabsPanel>
      ))}
    </Tabs>
  );
}

const releaseChannels = ["Stable", "Release candidate", "Beta", "Canary", "Nightly", "Experimental", "Long-term support"];

export function PrimitiveTabsExample() {
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-md flex-col gap-7">
      <Tabs defaultValue="preview">
        <TabsList aria-label="Document view">
          <TabsTab value="preview">Preview</TabsTab>
          <TabsTab value="code">Code</TabsTab>
          <TabsTab value="usage">Usage</TabsTab>
        </TabsList>
        <TabsPanel value="preview">Rendered output of the component.</TabsPanel>
        <TabsPanel value="code">The source you install and own.</TabsPanel>
        <TabsPanel value="usage">How to map runner data into props.</TabsPanel>
      </Tabs>

      <Tabs defaultValue="audio" orientation="vertical">
        <TabsList activateOnFocus aria-label="Settings sections">
          <TabsTab value="audio">Audio</TabsTab>
          <TabsTab value="video">Video</TabsTab>
          <TabsTab value="export" disabled>
            Export
          </TabsTab>
        </TabsList>
        <TabsPanel value="audio">Microphone and output volume.</TabsPanel>
        <TabsPanel value="video">Camera and recording quality.</TabsPanel>
      </Tabs>

      <Tabs defaultValue="Stable">
        <TabsList scrollable aria-label="Release channels">
          {releaseChannels.map((channel) => (
            <TabsTab key={channel} value={channel}>
              {channel}
            </TabsTab>
          ))}
        </TabsList>
        {releaseChannels.map((channel) => (
          <TabsPanel key={channel} value={channel}>
            Builds published to the {channel.toLowerCase()} channel.
          </TabsPanel>
        ))}
      </Tabs>

      <ClosableEditorTabs />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `tabs`
  - `indicator`: `data-activation-direction` (`down` | `left` | `none` | `right` | `up`), `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`)
  - `list`: `data-activation-direction` (`down` | `left` | `none` | `right` | `up`), `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-scrollable`, `data-single`, `data-size` (`lg` | `md` | `sm` | `xs`), `data-variant` (`browser` | `default`)
  - `panel`: `data-activation-direction` (`down` | `left` | `none` | `right` | `up`), `data-ending-style`, `data-hidden`, `data-index`, `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-slide` (`panel`), `data-slide-exiting`, `data-starting-style`
  - `root`: `data-activation-direction` (`down` | `left` | `none` | `right` | `up`), `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-slide` (`scope`)
  - `surface`
  - `tab`: `aria-selected` (`false` | `true`), `data-activation-direction` (`down` | `left` | `none` | `right` | `up`), `data-active`, `data-disabled`, `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`)

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### tabs

- `--cui-tabs-list-backdrop-filter`: `none`
- `--cui-tabs-indicator-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)`
- `--cui-tabs-list-shadow`: `inset 0 0 0 var(--control-rim-width) var(--control-rim), var(--shadow-inset)`
- `--cui-tabs-indicator-background-image`: `none`
- `--cui-tabs-surface-background`: `var(--background)`
- `--cui-tabs-surface-radius`: `var(--radius-panel)`
- `--cui-tabs-trigger-padding-inline`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3.5)`
- `--cui-tabs-trigger-padding-inline-start`: `var(--cui-tabs-trigger-padding-inline)`
- `--cui-tabs-trigger-padding-inline-end`: `var(--cui-tabs-trigger-padding-inline)`
- `--cui-tabs-trigger-radius`: `var(--radius-control)`
- `--cui-tabs-trigger-height`: `var(--control-h-sm)`
- `--cui-tabs-list-padding`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 1)`
- `--cui-tabs-list-radius`: `calc(
      var(--cui-tabs-trigger-radius) +
      clamp(0px, calc(var(--cui-tabs-trigger-radius) * 1000), var(--cui-tabs-list-padding))
    )`
- `--cui-tabs-list-background`: `var(--hover-fill)`
- `--cui-tabs-indicator-background`: `var(--background)`
- `--cui-tabs-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)`
- `--cui-tabs-font-size`: `var(--text-label)`
- `--cui-tabs-font-weight`: `var(--font-weight-medium)`
- `--cui-tabs-active-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-tabs-hover-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-tabs-border-color`: `var(--border)`
- `--cui-tabs-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)`
